occurrences.text: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
Then said the Jews unto him, Thou art not yet fifty years old, and hast thou seen Abraham?
Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken.
And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
